releaseNotes:
OmniControl Suite v8.16.5 - Rock-Solid Launch, Versioned Mutex & Complete Error Diagnostics:
- Versioned Mutex: Prevents previous version zombie processes or mutex locks from blocking fresh startup.
- Full Exception Dialogs: Any unexpected startup error is captured and displayed.
- Complete UI: Fully populated all 6 pages with Google Stitch OLED styling.
